issues.description: The `test_search_recipes` test case is incomplete. It only tests a single search scenario and doesn't cover other combinations of search parameters or edge cases like no results found.
The test cases do not verify the `instructions` field in the response data after creating or updating a recipe.
The test cases do not verify the `cooking_time` field in the response data after creating or updating a recipe.
The test cases do not verify the `tags` field in the response data after creating or updating a recipe.

The `test_create_recipe_missing_fields` test case only checks for the absence of the `tags` field. It should be expanded to test for the absence of other required fields like `title`, `ingredients`, `instructions`, and `cooking_time` individually.
The `test_search_recipes` test case creates only two recipes. For a more robust test, it should create a larger dataset to evaluate the performance of the search functionality under load.
